# Boim Thinks — Personal Portfolio & Vibe Coding Knowledge Hub
> Web personal Boim (@boimthinks), Software Developer & AI Agent Practitioner berdomisili di Palembang, Indonesia.

## Core Specialization
- Framework: Astro JS (SSR/SSG, Islands Architecture, Content Layer)
- Vibe Coding Harness: OpenCode CLI & Agent Framework
- Reasoning Models: Google Gemini, DeepSeek (R1 & V3)
- Styling & Performance: Tailwind CSS v4, Zero-JS default, View Transitions
- Architecture: Silo Hierarchy, Semantic Entity SEO, JSON-LD Schema.org

## Live Production Portfolios
- Laserindo Palembang (https://laserindopalembang.com): Jasa CNC laser cutting plat besi & stainless di Palembang.
- Pireki Indonesia (https://pireki.id): Partisi geser kedap suara ballroom & ruang rapat.
- Alfa Elektrindo (https://alfa.elektrindo.co.id): Komponen automasi industri & semikonduktor daya.
- Lincah Travel (https://lincahtravel.web.id): Travel shuttle door-to-door & sewa mobil antar kota.
- Sriwijaya Grafika (https://sriwijayagrafika.com): Digital printing, advertising & acrylic display Palembang.
- Interior Batam (https://interiorbatam.web.id): Kontraktor desain interior komersial & residensial Batam.
- Pagar Modern Palembang (https://pagarmodernpalembang.com): Pagar laser cutting minimalis modern & kanopi.
- Partisi Ruang Rapat (https://partisiruangrapat.web.id): Pintu partisi lipat movable wall peredam suara kantor.
